verdict.rationale: Inline completions and next-edit suggestions are a fair question for an AI coding assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes Gemini CLI only as a terminal agent: querying and editing codebases, non-interactive scripting, MCP extensions and PR reviews. Nothing shows as-you-type inline completions or next-edit suggestions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
